query:
SELECT status, last_seen_at,
                       (
                           SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
                               'ts', l.ts, 'level', l.level,
                               'source', l.source, 'message', l.message
                           ) ORDER BY l.ts)
                           FROM process_logs l
                           WHERE l.process_id = $1
                             AND ($2::text IS NULL OR l.ts > $2::timestamptz)
                           LIMIT 20
                       ) AS new_logs
                FROM processes WHERE id = $1
